items.title: 5.15 Real fluids viscous fluids hain (Roman Urdu)

blocks.title: Ideal aur real fluids
blocks.text: Ideal fluid woh fluid hai jis mein viscosity na ho aur jo dabaya na ja sake; is qism ka fluid amalan maujood nahi ho sakta. Har qism ke fluids jin mein viscosity ho real fluids mein shumar hote hain, maslan kerosene, arandi ka tel (castor oil) aur shehad.
Ideal aur real fluids ka muqabla

Ideal fluid ki misal nahi di ja sakti, kyunke yeh asal duniya mein maujood nahi balke sirf nazriye mein hai. Hamare gird har fluid, jaise pani, diesel, petrol aur shehad, real fluid hai. Viscosity ke farq asal zindagi mein milte hain, maslan shehad pani se zyada viscous hai. Bernoulli ki equation kehti hai ke fluid ke bahao ki speed fluid ki potential energy mein saath saath kami ya fluid par static dabao mein kami ke nateeje mein barhti hai. Jab fluid viscous ho to is se murad bunyadi taur par fluid ka gaarhapan ya woh raghrat hai jo fluid bahte hue mehsoos karta hai. Is liye ideal fluids mukhalif force nahi jhelte aur non-viscous bahao rakhte hain, jabke real fluids viscous bahao rakhte hain.

items: Ideal fluids incompressible hain: fluid ki na density na volume dabao se badalta hai, jabke real fluids kafi compressible hain.

Bulk modulus volume ki tabdeeli ke ulat tanasub mein hai; ideal fluids ke liye volume ki tabdeeli sifr hai, to ideal fluids ka bulk modulus la-mahdood hai. Real fluids volume ki tabdeeli jhelte hain aur is liye mahdood bulk modulus rakhte hain.
Chunke ideal fluids sirf nazriye mein hain, un par surface tension lagu nahi; real fluids ke liye surface tension lagu ho jati hai.

blocks.text: Saade lafzon mein ideal fluids khayali hain, yani qudrat mein maujood nahi, jabke real fluids waqai maujood hain. Ideal fluids mein koi viscosity nahi, ya kaha ja sakta hai ke sifr viscosity hai; real fluids mein viscosity hai.

blocks.prompt: Real fluid, ideal fluid aur superfluid mein kya farq hai, aur in mein se kaun sa waqai maujood hai (constructed response 5.5)?
blocks.explanation: Ideal fluid mein viscosity nahi, incompressible hai aur surface tension nahi; yeh sirf nazriye mein hai. Real fluid mein viscosity, kuch compressibility aur surface tension hai, aur har aam fluid yahi hai. Superfluid asal madda hai, jaise taqreeban 2 K se neeche helium-4, jis mein waqai sifr viscosity hai; real fluids aur superfluids maujood hain, ideal fluids nahi.

items: Ideal fluid: viscosity nahi, incompressible (la-mahdood bulk modulus), surface tension nahi, sirf nazriya. Real fluid: viscous (shehad pani se zyada), compressible, mahdood bulk modulus, surface tension: pani, diesel, petrol, shehad, kerosene, castor oil.
